        return s

        if not route:
            return 0
        c = dm[depot][route[0]] + dm[route[-1]][depot]

        best_pos = 0
        best_delta = dm[depot][node] + dm[node][route[0]] - (dm[depot][route[0]])
        # insert at end

            b = route[pos]
            delta = dm[a][node] + dm[node][b] - dm[a][b]
            if delta < best_delta:
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = pos

        a = route[-1]
        delta = dm[a][node] + dm[node][depot] - dm[a][depot]
